title: ARGUS SIEM Overview
description: События по классам, инциденты, ATT&CK-покрытие, вердикты аналитика, ПДн, ложные.

panels.title: События по классам источников
panels.sql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, source_class, count() AS events FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time, source_class ORDER BY time

panels.title: Открытых инцидентов
panels.sql: SELECT countIf(status NOT IN ('closed','false_positive')) AS open, countIf(status='escalated') AS escalated FROM (SELECT incident_id, argMax(status, updated_at) AS status FROM incidents GROUP BY incident_id)

panels.title: EPS по источникам (60 с)
panels.sql: SELECT source, round(sum(events_1m)/60, 1) AS eps FROM collector_health WHERE seen_at >= now() - INTERVAL 2 MINUTE GROUP BY source ORDER BY eps DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Инциденты по уровню и статусу
panels.sql: SELECT level, status, count() AS n FROM (SELECT incident_id, argMax(level, updated_at) AS level, argMax(status, updated_at) AS status, argMax(created_at, updated_at) AS created_at FROM incidents GROUP BY incident_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY level, status ORDER BY level, status

panels.title: Инциденты во времени по правилам
panels.sql: SELECT $__timeInterval(created_at) AS time, rule_id, count() AS n FROM (SELECT incident_id, argMax(rule_id, updated_at) AS rule_id, argMax(created_at, updated_at) AS created_at FROM incidents GROUP BY incident_id) WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time, rule_id ORDER BY time

panels.title: Покрытие ATT&CK тактиками (30 д)
panels.sql: SELECT replaceOne(tag, 'attack.', '') AS tactic, count() AS incidents FROM (SELECT incident_id, argMax(tags, updated_at) AS tags, argMax(created_at, updated_at) AS created_at FROM incidents GROUP BY incident_id) ARRAY JOIN tags AS tag WHERE tag LIKE 'attack.%' AND tag NOT LIKE 'attack.t%' AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY tag ORDER BY incidents DESC

panels.title: Вердикты аналитика
panels.sql: SELECT $__timeInterval(evaluated_at) AS time, countIf(shown=1 AND error='') AS shown_to_analyst, countIf(shown=0 AND error='') AS below_threshold, countIf(error!='') AS failed FROM incident_verdicts WHERE $__timeFilter(evaluated_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Доля событий с ПДн по источникам
panels.sql: SELECT source, round(100*avg(pii),1) AS pii_pct FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY source ORDER BY pii_pct DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Ложные срабатывания по правилам (30 д)
panels.sql: SELECT rule_id, count() AS incidents, countIf(status='false_positive') AS false_positive, round(100*countIf(status='false_positive')/count(),1) AS fp_pct FROM (SELECT incident_id, argMax(rule_id, updated_at) AS rule_id, argMax(status, updated_at) AS status, argMax(created_at, updated_at) AS created_at FROM incidents GROUP BY incident_id) WHERE created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY rule_id ORDER BY fp_pct DESC
